$comment: Everything a complete guide to IIUM should cover. Used by scripts/content-report.mjs (topics with no pages are reported as gaps) and by the monthly content refresh (.github/content-refresh.md), which writes pages for gaps. Paths are relative to src/content/docs. Add a topic with "pages": [] to ask for a page about it.
